staticUnit:
[Unit]
Description=ABLESTACK SharedFS static network restore
After=local-fs.target cloud-early-config.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/ablestack-storage/sharedfs-network.json

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/ablestack-sharedfs-network /etc/ablestack-storage/sharedfs-network.json
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
